```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(gstat)
library(ranger)
library(yardstick)
library(tidyterra)

dir.create("../outputs/spatial", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-inputs}
# ============================================================
# LOAD ALL INPUTS
# ============================================================

if (!exists("cov_stack")) {
  cov_stack <- terra::rast(
    "../data/spatial/covariate_stack_3m_all_with_SR_indices.tif"
  )
}

if (!exists("soil_pts")) {
  soil_pts <- sf::st_read(
    "../data/spatial/perry_pedon_locs.shp", quiet = TRUE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_transform(crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(cov_stack))) %>%
    rename(Point = Point_ID) %>%
    mutate(Point = as.character(Point))
}

if (!exists("cov_at_pedons")) {
  cov_at_pedons <- read.csv(
    "../outputs/spatial/covariates_at_pedons.csv"
  ) %>%
    mutate(Point = as.character(Point))
}

# Perry horizon data
perry_fp_clean <- read.csv(
  "../data/Perry_FP_data_with_taxa_02_20_2026.csv"
) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(Point))

# NCSS great group bundle
ncss_gg_bundle <- readRDS(
  "../outputs/models/taxgrtgroup_xgb_umap_hdb_bundle.rds"
)
ncss_gg_bundle$umap_fit <- uwot::load_uwot(
  "../outputs/models/taxgrtgroup_xgb_umap_hdb_umap.uwot"
)

# Perry pack for NCSS model deployment
if (!exists("perry_pack_150")) {
  perry_pack_150 <- read.csv(
    "../outputs/perry_pack_150_saved.rds"
  ) %>%
    mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))
}

cat("All inputs loaded.\n")
```

```{r build-labels}
# ============================================================
# BUILD GREAT GROUP LABELS — TWO VERSIONS
# Version A: from Perry field truth (taxgrtgroup column)
# Version B: from NCSS XGB+UMAP model predictions
# ============================================================

# ---- Version A: Perry truth labels ----
gg_truth <- perry_fp_clean %>%
  mutate(
    gg = na_if(str_squish(as.character(taxgrtgroup)), ""),
    gg = str_to_title(gg)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Point) %>%
  summarise(
    gg = {
      y <- gg[!is.na(gg)]
      if (length(y) == 0) NA_character_
      else names(sort(table(y), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  distinct(Point, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Perry truth great groups:\n")
gg_truth %>%
  filter(!is.na(gg)) %>%
  count(gg, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

# ---- Version B: NCSS model predictions at Perry pedons ----
# Deploy NCSS great group bundle to Perry pack

pad_like_train_raw <- function(new_df, train_df, outcome) {
  req <- setdiff(names(train_df), outcome)
  out <- new_df
  missing <- setdiff(req, names(out))
  for (nm in missing) {
    tmpl <- train_df[[nm]]
    if (str_detect(nm, "^prop_hzbase_"))    out[[nm]] <- 0
    else if (str_detect(nm, "^(any_|has_)")) out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    else if (is.logical(tmpl))  out[[nm]] <- FALSE
    else if (is.integer(tmpl))  out[[nm]] <- NA_integer_
    else if (is.numeric(tmpl))  out[[nm]] <- NA_real_
    else                        out[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  }
  out %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.logical), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, FALSE))) %>%
    select(any_of(c("peiid", req)))
}

perry_padded <- pad_like_train_raw(
  new_df   = perry_pack_150 %>% mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)),
  train_df = ncss_gg_bundle$train_raw,
  outcome  = ncss_gg_bundle$outcome
)

# Force column classes to match
for (nm in intersect(names(perry_padded), names(ncss_gg_bundle$train_raw))) {
  tmpl <- ncss_gg_bundle$train_raw[[nm]]
  if (is.integer(tmpl))    perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.integer(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.logical(tmpl))   perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.logical(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.numeric(tmpl))   perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.numeric(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.character(tmpl)) perry_padded[[nm]] <- as.character(perry_padded[[nm]])
  else if (is.factor(tmpl))    perry_padded[[nm]] <- factor(
    as.character(perry_padded[[nm]]), levels = levels(tmpl)
  )
}

# Bake through UMAP+HDBSCAN pipeline
x_perry <- bake(ncss_gg_bundle$prep_rec, new_data = perry_padded) %>%
  select(-any_of(c(ncss_gg_bundle$outcome, "peiid"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.logical), as.double)) %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

missing_baked <- setdiff(ncss_gg_bundle$x_cols, names(x_perry))
for (mc in missing_baked) x_perry[[mc]] <- 0
x_perry <- x_perry %>%
  select(all_of(ncss_gg_bundle$x_cols)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, 0)))

z_perry <- as.data.frame(
  uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_perry), ncss_gg_bundle$umap_fit)
)
names(z_perry) <- ncss_gg_bundle$umap_colnames

train_z  <- as.matrix(ncss_gg_bundle$train_umap_features)
nearest_idx <- apply(as.matrix(z_perry), 1, function(z) {
  d <- rowSums((train_z - matrix(z, nrow = nrow(train_z),
                                  ncol = ncol(train_z), byrow = TRUE))^2)
  which.min(d)
})

train_cluster  <- ncss_gg_bundle$hdb_fit$cluster
perry_cluster  <- train_cluster[nearest_idx]
hdb_levels     <- sort(unique(train_cluster))

perry_model_dat <- bind_cols(
  z_perry,
  hdb_cluster = factor(perry_cluster, levels = hdb_levels),
  hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(perry_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                       levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
)

ncss_gg_preds <- predict(ncss_gg_bundle$final_fit,
                          perry_model_dat, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(perry_padded %>% select(peiid))

# Map peiid -> Point
peiid_to_point <- perry_fp_clean %>%
  select(Point, peiid = Point) %>%
  distinct() 

gg_ncss_pred <- ncss_gg_preds %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  rename(gg = .pred_class) %>%
  mutate(Point = as.character(peiid)) %>%
  select(Point, gg) %>%
  distinct(Point, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(gg = as.character(gg))

cat("\nNCSS-predicted great groups at Perry pedons:\n")
gg_ncss_pred %>%
  count(gg, sort = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()
```

```{r loocv-function}
# ============================================================
# LOOCV FUNCTION (reusable for both versions)
# ============================================================

run_loocv <- function(model_df, label = "model") {

  n            <- nrow(model_df)
  gg_levels    <- levels(model_df$gg)
  n_classes    <- length(gg_levels)

  loocv_results <- tibble(
    Point    = character(n),
    true_gg  = character(n),
    pred_gg  = character(n),
    top1     = numeric(n)
  )

  loocv_probs <- matrix(
    NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = n_classes,
    dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("prob_", gg_levels))
  )

  cat("LOOCV [", label, "] n =", n, "classes =", n_classes, "\n")

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    train_i <- model_df[-i, ]
    test_i  <- model_df[i,  ]

    train_x <- train_i %>% select(all_of(cov_cols))
    test_x  <- test_i  %>% select(all_of(cov_cols))

    col_meds <- vapply(train_x, median, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
    for (nm in cov_cols) {
      train_x[[nm]][is.na(train_x[[nm]])] <- col_meds[nm]
      test_x[[nm]][is.na(test_x[[nm]])]   <- col_meds[nm]
    }

    rf_i <- ranger::ranger(
      x             = train_x,
      y             = train_i$gg,
      num.trees     = 1000,
      mtry          = max(2, floor(sqrt(length(cov_cols)))),
      min.node.size = 2,
      probability   = TRUE,
      seed          = 42 + i
    )

    pred_i   <- predict(rf_i, data = test_x)$predictions
    prob_row <- rep(NA_real_, n_classes)
    names(prob_row) <- gg_levels
    matched <- intersect(gg_levels, colnames(pred_i))
    prob_row[matched] <- pred_i[1, matched]

    loocv_probs[i, ] <- prob_row
    pred_class <- gg_levels[which.max(prob_row)]

    loocv_results$Point[i]   <- model_df$Point[i]
    loocv_results$true_gg[i] <- as.character(model_df$gg[i])
    loocv_results$pred_gg[i] <- pred_class
    loocv_results$top1[i]    <- max(prob_row, na.rm = TRUE)

    if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == n) cat("  Fold", i, "/", n, "\n")
  }

  loocv_results <- loocv_results %>%
    mutate(
      correct = true_gg == pred_gg,
      true_gg = factor(true_gg, levels = gg_levels),
      pred_gg = factor(pred_gg, levels = gg_levels)
    )

  list(results = loocv_results, probs = loocv_probs,
       gg_levels = gg_levels)
}

print_loocv_metrics <- function(loocv, label = "") {
  r <- loocv$results
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("LOOCV RESULTS:", label, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", round(mean(r$correct, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("Kappa:   ", round(yardstick::kap_vec(r$true_gg, r$pred_gg), 3), "\n")
  cat("Macro F1:", round(yardstick::f_meas_vec(
    r$true_gg, r$pred_gg, estimator = "macro"), 3), "\n")

  cat("\nPer-class accuracy:\n")
  r %>%
    group_by(true_gg) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), n_correct = sum(correct),
              acc = round(n_correct / n, 2),
              mean_prob = round(mean(top1), 2),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(acc)) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    print()

  cat("\nMisclassification pairs:\n")
  r %>%
    filter(!correct) %>%
    count(true_gg, pred_gg, sort = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    print()
}
```

```{r fit-final-rf-and-map}
# ============================================================
# FIT FINAL RF + WALL-TO-WALL MAP (for both versions)
# ============================================================

fit_final_and_map <- function(model_df, loocv, label, file_suffix) {

  gg_levels <- loocv$gg_levels
  n         <- nrow(model_df)

  # Impute NAs
  full_x <- model_df %>% select(all_of(cov_cols))
  col_meds <- vapply(full_x, median, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
  for (nm in cov_cols) {
    full_x[[nm]][is.na(full_x[[nm]])] <- col_meds[nm]
  }

  set.seed(42)
  rf_final <- ranger::ranger(
    x             = full_x,
    y             = model_df$gg,
    num.trees     = 1500,
    mtry          = max(2, floor(sqrt(length(cov_cols)))),
    min.node.size = 2,
    probability   = TRUE,
    importance    = "permutation",
    seed          = 42
  )

  cat("\n[", label, "] OOB error:",
      round(rf_final$prediction.error, 3), "\n")

  # ---- Variograms on RF residuals ----
  insample_probs <- rf_final$predictions
  variogram_fits <- list()
  krige_models   <- list()

  # Field diagonal for range sanity check
  field_ext  <- terra::ext(cov_stack)
  field_diag <- sqrt((field_ext$xmax - field_ext$xmin)^2 +
                     (field_ext$ymax - field_ext$ymin)^2)
  max_range  <- field_diag * 0.4

  for (s in gg_levels) {
    if (!s %in% colnames(insample_probs)) next

    # Only krige series with enough pedons
    n_s <- sum(as.character(model_df$gg) == s)
    if (n_s < 5) next

    resid_sf <- tibble(
      coord_X  = model_df$coord_X,
      coord_Y  = model_df$coord_Y,
      observed = as.integer(as.character(model_df$gg) == s),
      residual = observed - insample_probs[, s]
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(residual)) %>%
      sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
                   crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

    vgm_emp <- tryCatch(
      gstat::variogram(residual ~ 1, data = resid_sf),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(vgm_emp)) next

    vgm_fit <- tryCatch(
      gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm(c("Sph", "Exp"))),
      error = function(e) tryCatch(
        gstat::fit.variogram(vgm_emp, gstat::vgm("Exp")),
        error = function(e2) NULL
      )
    )
    if (is.null(vgm_fit)) next

    # Skip unreliable ranges
    range_val <- vgm_fit$range[2]
    if (!is.finite(range_val) || range_val <= 0 ||
        range_val > max_range) {
      cat("  Skipping", s, "-- range", round(range_val, 1),
          "outside reliable bounds.\n")
      next
    }

    variogram_fits[[s]] <- list(empirical = vgm_emp, fitted = vgm_fit)
    krige_models[[s]]   <- list(data = resid_sf, vgm = vgm_fit)
    cat("  Variogram:", s, "| Range:", round(range_val, 1), "\n")
  }

  # ---- Wall-to-wall RF prediction ----
  cov_df <- terra::as.data.frame(
    cov_stack[[cov_cols]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE
  )
  n_pix    <- nrow(cov_df)
  cov_pred <- cov_df %>% select(all_of(cov_cols)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
  for (nm in cov_cols) {
    cov_pred[[nm]][is.na(cov_pred[[nm]])] <- col_meds[nm]
  }

  chunk_size <- 50000
  n_chunks   <- ceiling(n_pix / chunk_size)
  prob_list  <- vector("list", n_chunks)

  cat("  Predicting", n_chunks, "chunks...\n")
  for (i in seq_len(n_chunks)) {
    idx <- ((i-1)*chunk_size + 1):min(i*chunk_size, n_pix)
    prob_list[[i]] <- as.data.frame(
      predict(rf_final, data = cov_pred[idx,, drop=FALSE])$predictions
    )
  }
  all_probs <- bind_rows(prob_list)

  # Build raster stack
  prob_raster_list <- list()
  for (s in gg_levels) {
    if (!s %in% names(all_probs)) next
    r <- terra::rast(cov_stack[[1]])
    terra::values(r) <- all_probs[[s]]
    names(r) <- paste0("prob_", s)
    if (any(is.finite(terra::values(r)))) prob_raster_list[[s]] <- r
  }
  prob_rasters <- terra::rast(prob_raster_list)

  # ---- Apply kriging corrections ----
  if (length(krige_models) > 0) {
    pred_grid <- terra::as.data.frame(
      cov_stack[[1]], xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE
    ) %>%
      select(x, y) %>%
      sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"),
                   crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

    for (s in names(krige_models)) {
      kr <- tryCatch(
        gstat::krige(residual ~ 1,
                     locations = krige_models[[s]]$data,
                     newdata   = pred_grid,
                     model     = krige_models[[s]]$vgm,
                     debug.level = 0),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(kr)) next

      kr_rast <- terra::rasterize(
        terra::vect(kr %>% mutate(v = var1.pred) %>% select(v)),
        cov_stack[[1]], field = "v", fun = "mean"
      )

      lnm <- paste0("prob_", s)
      if (lnm %in% names(prob_rasters)) {
        prob_rasters[[lnm]] <- terra::clamp(
          prob_rasters[[lnm]] + kr_rast, 0, 1
        )
      }
    }
  }

  # ---- Final classified map ----
  fitted_gg <- str_remove(names(prob_rasters), "^prob_")
  pred_idx  <- terra::which.lyr(prob_rasters)
  names(pred_idx) <- "predicted_gg_idx"

  # Sanity check pixel distribution
  cat("\n  Pixel counts:\n")
  pv <- fitted_gg[terra::values(pred_idx)]
  print(sort(table(pv, useNA = "ifany"), decreasing = TRUE))

  # ---- Save rasters ----
  terra::writeRaster(
    prob_rasters,
    paste0("../outputs/spatial/gg_prob_stack_", file_suffix, ".tif"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  terra::writeRaster(
    pred_idx,
    paste0("../outputs/spatial/gg_predicted_", file_suffix, ".tif"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  list(
    rf_final       = rf_final,
    prob_rasters   = prob_rasters,
    pred_idx       = pred_idx,
    fitted_gg      = fitted_gg,
    variogram_fits = variogram_fits,
    col_meds       = col_meds
  )
}

cat("Fitting Model A (truth labels)...\n")
result_A <- fit_final_and_map(model_df_A, loocv_A,
                               "Perry truth", "truth")

cat("\nFitting Model B (NCSS predicted labels)...\n")
result_B <- fit_final_and_map(model_df_B, loocv_B,
                               "NCSS predicted", "ncss")
```

```{r visualize}
# ============================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================

make_map <- function(result, loocv, model_df, pts_xy_dedup,
                     title, file_suffix) {

  fitted_gg <- result$fitted_gg
  n_gg      <- length(fitted_gg)

  # Factor raster
  pred_factor <- terra::as.factor(result$pred_idx)
  levels(pred_factor) <- data.frame(
    value = seq_along(fitted_gg),
    gg    = fitted_gg
  )

  # Colour palette
  gg_colors <- scales::hue_pal()(n_gg)
  names(gg_colors) <- fitted_gg

  # 1. Predicted map
  p_map <- ggplot() +
    tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = pred_factor) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = gg_colors,
                      na.value = "grey90",
                      name    = "Great Group") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title    = paste("Predicted Great Group —", title),
         subtitle = "RF + Regression Kriging (LOOCV validated, 3m)")
  print(p_map)
  ggsave(paste0("../outputs/spatial/map_gg_", file_suffix, ".png"),
         p_map, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)

  # 2. LOOCV validation overlay
  loocv_sf <- loocv$results %>%
    left_join(pts_xy_dedup, by = "Point") %>%
    filter(!is.na(coord_X)) %>%
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("coord_X", "coord_Y"),
                 crs = sf::st_crs(soil_pts))

  p_val <- ggplot() +
    tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = pred_factor) +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = gg_colors,
                      na.value = "grey90",
                      name     = "Predicted (map)") +
    geom_sf(data = loocv_sf,
            aes(color = true_gg, shape = correct),
            size = 3, stroke = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = gg_colors, name = "True GG") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 4),
                       name   = "LOOCV correct?") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title    = paste("LOOCV Overlay —", title),
         subtitle = "Circle = correct  |  X = misclassified")
  print(p_val)
  ggsave(paste0("../outputs/spatial/map_gg_loocv_", file_suffix, ".png"),
         p_val, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 200)

  # 3. Probability surfaces
  for (s in fitted_gg) {
    lnm <- paste0("prob_", s)
    if (!lnm %in% names(result$prob_rasters)) next
    p <- ggplot() +
      tidyterra::geom_spatraster(
        data = result$prob_rasters[[lnm]]
      ) +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdYlGn", direction = 1,
                           na.value = "grey90", limits = c(0, 1),
                           name = "Probability") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(title    = paste("Probability:", s, "|", title),
           subtitle = "RF + kriging correction")
    print(p)
  }

  # 4. Variable importance
  imp_df <- tibble(
    variable   = names(result$rf_final$variable.importance),
    importance = result$rf_final$variable.importance
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
    mutate(variable = fct_reorder(variable, importance))

  p_imp <- ggplot(imp_df %>% slice_head(n = 20),
                  aes(x = importance, y = variable)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste("Variable Importance —", title),
         x = "Permutation Importance", y = NULL)
  print(p_imp)
  ggsave(paste0("../outputs/spatial/imp_gg_", file_suffix, ".png"),
         p_imp, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 200)

  invisible(NULL)
}

make_map(result_A, loocv_A, model_df_A, pts_xy_dedup,
         "Perry Truth Labels", "truth")
make_map(result_B, loocv_B, model_df_B, pts_xy_dedup,
         "NCSS Predicted Labels", "ncss")
```

```{r summary}
# ============================================================
# COMPARISON SUMMARY
# ============================================================

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("GREAT GROUP SPATIAL PREDICTION — COMPARISON SUMMARY\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

for (lab in c("A: Perry truth", "B: NCSS predicted")) {

  res  <- if (str_detect(lab, "A")) loocv_A$results else loocv_B$results
  mdf  <- if (str_detect(lab, "A")) model_df_A      else model_df_B
  rfin <- if (str_detect(lab, "A")) result_A$rf_final else result_B$rf_final
  vgms <- if (str_detect(lab, "A")) result_A$variogram_fits else
                                    result_B$variogram_fits

  cat("\n---", lab, "---\n")
  cat("Pedons:", nrow(mdf), "| Classes:", nlevels(mdf$gg), "\n")
  cat("LOOCV Accuracy:", round(mean(res$correct, na.rm=TRUE), 3), "\n")
  cat("LOOCV Kappa:   ",
      round(yardstick::kap_vec(res$true_gg, res$pred_gg), 3), "\n")
  cat("LOOCV Macro F1:",
      round(yardstick::f_meas_vec(res$true_gg, res$pred_gg,
                                   estimator = "macro"), 3), "\n")
  cat("OOB Error:     ", round(rfin$prediction.error, 3), "\n")
  cat("Variograms fitted:", length(vgms), "\n")
  if (length(vgms) > 0) {
    for (s in names(vgms)) {
      cat(" ", s, "range:",
          round(vgms[[s]]$fitted$range[2], 1), "map units\n")
    }
  }
}
```
